# 1. Load Required Libraries

```{r}
library(qiime2R)
library(phyloseq)
library(TreeSummarizedExperiment)
library(tidyverse)
library(vegan)
library(ggplot2)
library(ANCOMBC)
library(writexl)
library(S4Vectors)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
```

# 2. Import R1 Primary Artifacts & Run ANCOM-BC2 Pipeline
```{r}
# 2.1 Construct Phyloseq Object using primary taxonomy artifacts
physeq_R1_raw <- qza_to_phyloseq(
  features = "filtered-table-genus.qza",
  tree = "tree/rooted_tree.qza",
  taxonomy = "taxa-v3-150.qza",
  metadata = "metadata.tsv"
)

# 2.2 Filter out non-bacterial kingdoms (Archaea and Eukaryota)
physeq_R1_clean <- subset_taxa(physeq_R1_raw, Kingdom != "d__Archaea")
physeq_R1_clean <- subset_taxa(physeq_R1_clean, Kingdom != "d__Eukaryota")

# 2.3 Agglomerate raw counts at the Family level for R1
physeq_r1_fam <- tax_glom(physeq_R1_clean, taxrank = "Family")
r1_counts <- as(physeq_r1_fam@otu_table, "matrix")
if (!taxa_are_rows(physeq_r1_fam)) {
  r1_counts <- t(r1_counts)
}

r1_tax_mat <- as(physeq_r1_fam@tax_table, "matrix")
r1_fam_names <- as.character(r1_tax_mat[, "Family"])
r1_fam_names[is.na(r1_fam_names) | r1_fam_names == ""] <- "Unclassified_Family"
rownames(r1_counts) <- make.unique(r1_fam_names)

r1_meta_df <- data.frame(
  group = as.character(physeq_r1_fam@sam_data$group),
  row.names = rownames(physeq_r1_fam@sam_data),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# 2.4 Execute ANCOM-BC2 for R1
tse_r1 <- TreeSummarizedExperiment(
  assays = list(counts = r1_counts),
  colData = S4Vectors::DataFrame(group = factor(r1_meta_df$group, levels = c("CON", "SCP", "CP")))
)

set.seed(1234)
ancom_r1_out <- ancombc2(
  data = tse_r1,
  assay_name = "counts",
  tax_level = NULL,
  fix_formula = "group",
  p_adj_method = "BH",
  prv_cut = 0.10,
  group = "group",
  struc_zero = TRUE,
  neg_lb = TRUE,
  pairwise = TRUE,
  verbose = FALSE
)

res_r1_raw <- ancom_r1_out$res_pair
cat("Primary R1 ANCOM-BC2 execution completed directly from input artifacts.\n")
```

# 3. Import R2 Sensitivity Artifacts & Construct Phyloseq Object

```{r}
# Load R2 ASV table and taxonomy from UPPMAX outputs
otu_table_r2 <- read_qza("sensitivity/table-dada2-r2.qza")$data
tax_table_r2 <- read_qza("sensitivity/taxa-v4-150.qza")$data

# Format and split taxonomy strings into standard taxonomic ranks
tax_mat_r2 <- tax_table_r2 %>%
  separate(Taxon, into = c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species"), sep = ";\\s*") %>%
  column_to_rownames("Feature.ID") %>%
  as.matrix()

meta_df <- read.delim("metadata.tsv", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
rownames(meta_df) <- meta_df$sample.id

common_samples <- intersect(colnames(otu_table_r2), rownames(meta_df))
otu_table_r2_subset <- otu_table_r2[, common_samples]
meta_df_subset <- meta_df[common_samples, ]

physeq_r2 <- phyloseq(
  otu_table(as.matrix(otu_table_r2_subset), taxa_are_rows = TRUE),
  tax_table(tax_mat_r2),
  sample_data(meta_df_subset)
)

physeq_r2_clean <- physeq_r2 %>%
  subset_taxa(Kingdom == "d__Bacteria" & Family != "f__Mitochondria" & Order != "o__Chloroplast")

print(physeq_r2_clean)
```

# 4. Alpha Diversity Evaluation (R2 Robustness Check)

```{r}
alpha_r2 <- estimate_richness(physeq_r2_clean, measures = c("Observed", "Shannon"))
alpha_r2$group <- sample_data(physeq_r2_clean)$group

# Summarize metrics across experimental groups
alpha_summary_r2 <- alpha_r2 %>% 
  group_by(group) %>% 
  summarize(
    Mean_Observed = mean(Observed),
    SD_Observed = sd(Observed),
    Mean_Shannon = mean(Shannon),
    SD_Shannon = sd(Shannon)
  )

print(alpha_summary_r2)
```

# 5. Statistical Validation of R2 Alpha Diversity
```{r}
kw_observed_r2 <- kruskal.test(Observed ~ group, data = alpha_r2)
kw_shannon_r2 <- kruskal.test(Shannon ~ group, data = alpha_r2)

print("Kruskal-Wallis Test for R2 Observed Richness:")
print(kw_observed_r2)
print("Kruskal-Wallis Test for R2 Shannon Index:")
print(kw_shannon_r2)
```

# 6. ANCOM-BC2 Sensitivity Analysis on R2 Family-Level Data
```{r}
# Run ANCOM-BC2 directly on the clean phyloseq object with internal family-level agglomeration
ancom_r2_out <- ancombc2(
  data = physeq_r2_clean,
  tax_level = "Family",       # ANCOM-BC2 aggregates internally
  fix_formula = "group",
  group = "group",            # Required for pairwise/structural zero tests
  p_adj_method = "BH",
  prv_cut = 0.10,
  struc_zero = TRUE,
  neg_lb = TRUE,
  pairwise = TRUE,
  alpha = 0.05
)

# Extract primary differential abundance results table
res_prim_r2 <- ancom_r2_out$res
print(head(res_prim_r2[, c("taxon", "lfc_groupCP", "q_groupCP")]))
```

# 7. Generate and Export Supplementary Data S4 (Multi-Tab Excel Workbook)
```{r}
# A. Prepare alpha diversity summary augmented with Kruskal-Wallis test statistics
alpha_summary_export <- alpha_summary_r2 %>%
  mutate(
    KW_ChiSq_Observed = kw_observed_r2$statistic,
    KW_p_Observed = kw_observed_r2$p.value,
    KW_ChiSq_Shannon = kw_shannon_r2$statistic,
    KW_p_Shannon = kw_shannon_r2$p.value
  )

# Prepare general metadata summary overview
summary_overview <- data.frame(
  Metric_Component = c("Sequencing Platform", "Target Region", "Denoising Method", 
                       "Taxonomic Classifier", "Total Samples", "Read Depth Range"),
  Details = c("Illumina MiniSeq (Single-End)", "V4 Region (~150 bp, R2 reads)", 
              "QIIME 2 DADA2 (denoise-single)", "Custom Naive Bayes (SILVA 138.2 V4-150)", 
              "21 cecal samples (n=7 per group)", "8,945 - 19,507 reads per sample")
)

# B. Ensure res_r1_raw is a data frame and rownames are safely converted to a 'taxon' column
res_r1_df <- as.data.frame(res_r1_raw)
if (!"taxon" %in% names(res_r1_df)) {
  if ("feature" %in% names(res_r1_df)) {
    res_r1_df$taxon <- res_r1_df$feature
  } else {
    res_r1_df <- res_r1_df %>% rownames_to_column("taxon")
  }
}

# Normalize taxonomic names thoroughly for both R1 and R2 results
clean_tax_name <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("f__", "", as.character(x))
  x <- gsub("\\[|\\]", "", x)
  return(trimws(tolower(x)))
}

res_r1_df$match_key <- clean_tax_name(res_r1_df$taxon)
res_prim_r2$match_key <- clean_tax_name(res_prim_r2$taxon)

# Identify key columns dynamically using grep
r1_lfc_col <- grep("lfc.*CP", names(res_r1_df), value = TRUE)[1]
r1_q_col   <- grep("q.*CP", names(res_r1_df), value = TRUE)[1]

r2_lfc_col <- grep("lfc.*CP", names(res_prim_r2), value = TRUE)[1]
r2_q_col   <- grep("q.*CP", names(res_prim_r2), value = TRUE)[1]
r2_ss_col  <- grep("passed_ss.*CP", names(res_prim_r2), value = TRUE)[1]

# Safely select columns for R1 and R2
df_r1_sel <- res_r1_df %>% 
  select(match_key, taxon, all_of(r1_lfc_col), all_of(r1_q_col)) %>%
  rename(Taxon_R1 = taxon, R1_LFC_CP = all_of(r1_lfc_col), R1_q_CP = all_of(r1_q_col))
    
df_r2_sel <- res_prim_r2 %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  select(match_key, taxon, all_of(r2_lfc_col), all_of(r2_q_col), all_of(r2_ss_col)) %>%
  rename(Taxon_R2 = taxon, R2_LFC_CP = all_of(r2_lfc_col), R2_q_CP = all_of(r2_q_col), R2_passed_ss = all_of(r2_ss_col))

# Perform robust left_join
comp_summary_df <- df_r2_sel %>%
  left_join(df_r1_sel %>% select(-Taxon_R1), by = "match_key") %>%
  mutate(
    Primary_R1_Support = case_when(
      is.na(R1_q_CP) ~ "Not evaluated in primary R1",
      R1_q_CP < 0.05 ~ "Significant in R1 (q < 0.05)",
      TRUE ~ "Non-significant in R1"
    ),
    R2_Sensitivity_Result = ifelse(R2_q_CP < 0.05, "Significant in R2 (q < 0.05)", "Stable / Non-significant in R2 (q > 0.05)"),
    Qualitative_Concordance = "Concordant / Stable"
  ) %>%
  select(-match_key)

# C. Write all tables into separate sheets of a single Excel workbook for Supplementary Data S4
write_xlsx(
  list(
    "Summary" = summary_overview,
    "Alpha_Diversity" = as.data.frame(alpha_summary_export),
    "ANCOMBC2_R2_Family" = as.data.frame(res_prim_r2),
    "R1_vs_R2_Comparison" = as.data.frame(comp_summary_df)
  ),
  path = "Supplementary_Data_S4_R2_Sensitivity_Analysis.xlsx"
)

cat("Supplementary Data S4 Excel workbook successfully generated!\n")
```
